description: This file defines the 'Api' class within the OpenCart system, specifically handling API-related database operations for user APIs such as retrieving API info by username, fetching associated IPs, and adding API usage history.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Model class providing API-related database functions such as retrieving API info by username, getting IP records, and logging API call history.

methods.name: getApiByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves API details from the database for a given username.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Fetches IP address records associated with a specific API ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Inserts a new API call record into the history table, logging API usage.
